tiktok.caption:
My ADHD brain called me lazy at 3pm 🧠

I'd been at my desk since 8, staring at a logo brief for 4 hours. My brain: see? lazy. Me: lazy people don't feel this bad about it. I knew what the client wanted. I just couldn't see step 1. So I told FOCO. Step 1: write 3 words the brand should feel. 3 minutes. By 5:15 I had 3 sketches.

Has your brain called you lazy today? 👇
Save this for the next time your brain says "lazy" 📌

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting. The app on the slides is FOCO, link in bio 💜
